metadata.title: SSPP – Secure Container Platform
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan asserting institutional requirements for secure, resilient, and governed container runtime and orchestration platforms.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, governance, and resiliency requirements applicable to shared container execution environments.

system-characteristics.system-description: Container platform providing orchestrated, isolated, observable, and resilient execution environments for workloads and platform services using a managed container runtime and scheduler.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP asserts secure and resilient container execution and orchestration as a foundational platform capability.

props.name: execution-scope
props.remarks: Container workloads are scheduled and managed by a centralized control plane with enforced isolation and policy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance addressing recovery, adaptation, rapid reconfiguration, and workload restart under fault or attack conditions within orchestrated execution environments.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for container-specific security guidance addressing image integrity, runtime isolation, orchestration security, and container platform risk. This guidance informs Secure Container Platform design, while cyber-resiliency intent is provided by NIST SP 800-184.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP asserts Secure Container execution by composition of platform container patterns. It defines no workload-specific controls; compliance is achieved through satisfaction of the referenced container platform patterns.

components.title: Secure Container Platform (Composite Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that the container platform enforces isolation, integrity, availability, and resiliency for scheduled workloads.

roles.title: Container Platform Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional posture, risk tolerance, and resiliency expectations for container execution environments.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Container Platform Architect
roles.remarks: Designs container architecture, orchestration control planes, recovery strategies, and dependencies with Secure-Virtualization, Secure-Networking, and Secure-Time.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Container Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates container runtimes, schedulers, admission controllers, and recovery mechanisms in accordance with platform patterns.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Container Security Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors container platform telemetry, detects policy violations or degradation, and supports incident response and resiliency assessment.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through inherited control implementations in Secure Container platform constituent patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone or compensating controls.
